title: TransAct to Report Q3 2026 Results on November 12
summary: TransAct Technologies (Nasdaq: TACT) will report third quarter 2026 results after market close Nov. 12 and host a webcast at 4:30 p.m. ET.
body_markdown:
October 29, 2026


[PDF Version](https://transacttech.gcs-web.com/node/20561/pdf)


HAMDEN, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 29, 2026-- TransAct Technologies Incorporated (Nasdaq: TACT), a global leader in software-driven technology and printing solutions for high-growth markets, announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 results after the market close on Thursday, November 12, 2026 and will host a conference call and simultaneous webcast at 4:30 p.m. ET that day.


The conference call number is 844-826-3033; and the conference ID is 10212894. Please call ten minutes in advance to ensure that you are connected prior to the presentation. Interested parties may also access the live call on the Internet at[www.transact-tech.com](https://www.transact-tech.com/) (select “Investor Relations” followed by “Events & Presentations”).


Following its completion, an archived version of the webcast will be available for replay at the same location. A replay of the call will also be available starting roughly 3 hours after the call has ended and will continue until Thursday, November 26, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. The replay call number is 844-512-2921 with passcode 10212894.


About TransAct Technologies Incorporated


TransAct Technologies Incorporated is a global leader in integrated solutions that enable the world’s most valued brands to operate more efficiently, effectively, and economically. Its integrated solutions help digitally transform foodservices, and casino and gaming operations worldwide. In casino and gaming, EPIC by TransAct powers gaming environments with high-speed TITO, table games and kiosk printing, while EPICENTRAL® enables real-time player engagement to enhance the customer experience and drive revenue. With nearly 22,000 units in use globally, BOHA!® helps customers strengthen food safety, streamline operations and provide visibility and control to large brand name multi-location food service companies. Together, these solutions are engineered to make every transaction count. For more information, visit[www.transact-tech.com](https://www.transact-tech.com/) .
